Crispy Halibut Piccata
Lemon · Capers · Beurre Blanc · Parm-Crusted Zucchini · Spinach
The Story

Crispy halibut over a light beurre blanc with lemon and capers. Plated with parmesan-crusted zucchini and sautéed spinach.

Piccata is the Italian-American sister to scaloppine — lemon, butter, capers, white wine. Traditionally veal or chicken; here it carries a thick cut of halibut and a crisp parmesan crust does the work of the flour dredge.

Halibut is dense, sweet, white-fleshed Pacific fish. The crust stays crisp under the sauce. The sauce stays light. The capers cut the richness.
